What this model does

Real learned allocation on a fixed tissue lattice. The controller has 24 weights, no cell IDs, no coordinates, and no assigned organ map. Energy exchange and chemical propagation use neighboring cells only.

Feeding, transport, and collective thrust are simplified simulation rules. The initial body is a disk. Removed cells stay removed: this experiment tests reassignment of surviving tissue, not regrowth or biological realism.
